```{r setup}
library(DBI)
library(RMariaDB)
library(xtable)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# --- Parameters: edit these each month ---
month <- 4
year  <- 2026
```

```{r query}
monthyr <- paste(month.abb[month], year)
caption_label <- paste0(year, sprintf("%02d", month))

con <- dbConnect(
  RMariaDB::MariaDB(),
  dbname   = "aavso",
  host     = "localhost",
  user     = "root",
  password = "dJj135790",
  port     = 3333
)

obs_query <- sprintf("
  SELECT d.Obs, COUNT(*) AS n_obs, c.name AS observer_name
  FROM sun_data d
  LEFT JOIN sun_obsconst c
    ON d.Obs = c.Obs AND c.revised = 0
  WHERE d.monthyr = '%s'
    AND d.revised = 0
    AND d.Obs NOT IN ('BSJ1', 'TMT', 'WEO')
  GROUP BY d.Obs, c.name
  ORDER BY d.Obs
", monthyr)

result <- dbGetQuery(con, obs_query)
dbDisconnect(con)
```

```{r build-table}
df <- data.frame(
  `Observer Code`          = result$Obs,
  `Number of Observations` = as.integer(result$n_obs),
  `Observer Name`          = gsub("&", "/",
                               ifelse(is.na(result$observer_name), "UNKNOWN",
                                      result$observer_name),
                               fixed = TRUE),
  check.names = FALSE
)

totals_row <- data.frame(
  `Observer Code`          = "Totals",
  `Number of Observations` = sum(df$`Number of Observations`),
  `Observer Name`          = as.character(nrow(df)),
  check.names = FALSE
)

df_with_totals <- rbind(df, totals_row)
```

```{r render-table}
kbl(
  df_with_totals,
  format    = "latex",
  booktabs  = TRUE,
  longtable = TRUE,
  caption   = paste0(caption_label, " Number of observations by observer."),
  label     = "obs",
  col.names = c("Observer Code", "Number of Observations", "Observer Name")
) |>
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("repeat_header"),
    font_size     = 10
  ) |>
  row_spec(nrow(df_with_totals) - 1, hline_after = TRUE)
```

```{r write-tex}
tbl <- xtable(
  df_with_totals,
  caption = paste0(caption_label, " Number of observations by observer."),
  label   = "tab:obs"
)

print(tbl,
  tabular.environment    = "longtable",
  floating               = FALSE,
  include.rownames       = FALSE,
  hline.after            = c(-1, 0, nrow(df_with_totals) - 1, nrow(df_with_totals)),
  add.to.row = list(
    pos     = list(0),
    command = c(
      "  \\toprule \nObserver & Number of & \\\\ \nCode & Observations & Observer Name \\\\\n\\hline \n\\endhead \n\\hline \n{\\footnotesize Continued} \n\\endfoot \n\\endlastfoot\n"
    )
  ),
  sanitize.text.function = identity,
  file = paste0(caption_label, "Observers.tex")
)

cat("Written to", paste0(caption_label, "Observers.tex"), "\n")
```
